eldora.note: 5:48 AM update – Good morning, skiers and riders! Welcome to the Eldora snow report for Saturday, April 4, 2026. It's Closing Weekend—and also Retro Weekend, so break out your best retro gear and outfits and come hotdog with us today, the penultimate day of the 25/26 season. It's shaping up to be a banger, with sunny skies, a high near 42, and breezes from the west. After below freezing temps since Thursday night, surfaces will be firm in the morning and start softening as the day unfolds. Spring corn, anyone? The 24th Annual DOJoe Memorial Uphill/Downhill Costume Race happens today, and there's still time to join! Learn more and register now at eldora.com/events . This super-fun raises funds for the Friends of CAIC, so jump in and support the cause—we'd love to see you! You won't want to miss the party today or tomorrow! DJ Deeprawk Dave will be spinning 9-12 today in the BoomBox, and then the Goonies kick off at 12:30, right after the DOJoe Awards and raffle. Oh, and lift tickets are only $49 through Sunday. Click here to see everything we've got planned for the final weekend of the season. We'll see you soon! NWS Weather Snapshot: Sunny, with a high near 42. Breezy, with a west wind 9 to 16 mph, with gusts as high as 25 mph. Uphill and Nordic Skiing... The Nordic Center is now closed for the season. Check Nordic Pulse for the latest update. Uphill Access is now closed for the season. Visit eldora.com/uphill for more info. 2026-27 season passes are now on sale . Lock in your lowest price now, before prices increase on April 30. Stay in the loop: This page, eldora.com/conditions , is always your go-to for the latest updates, but you can also sign up for text alerts so you never miss a beat. Text one of the following keywords to (866) 965-6224: ELDORA for general alerts, UPHILL for uphill-specific updates, or NORDIC for Nordic updates. Message and data rates may apply. Thanks for checking the Eldora snow report. We'll see you on the hill! -- GENERAL INFORMATION Lift Hours: 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, seven days a week. Lodge Hours: 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM, seven days a week. High-Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) Parking: Per Boulder County requirements, the Elk Lot (nearest to Alpenglow chair) is reserved seven days a week for vehicles with three or more occupants on a first-come, first-served basis. Learn more here . EV Parking: Eldora provides 30 free ChargePoint EV charging stations. These premium parking spots are available on a first-come, first-served basis and are subject to the SOV policy above. To park in the EV lot, you MUST have an EV and be actively charging. If you are finished charging, please move your car to another non-EV space so others can use the chargers. Easy, Convenient RTD Bus Service from Boulder: RTD’s NB route brings you from Downtown Boulder Station straight to the Alpenglow chairlift in about 40 minutes; riders 19 and under ride RTD for FREE through RTD's Zero Fare for Youth program. For schedule and fare info, visit rtd-denver.com

killington.note: Hey, Beast family! The spring stoke is alive and well at The Beast. Today, we enjoyed sunny skies, soft snow, and a great party at the Bear Mountain Mogul Challenge. Thank you all for coming out for a great time. The good times roll on this Sunday, and we hope to see you out there on the slopes. Temps tonight will drop into the 30s before rising back to around 40 degrees during the day on Sunday. We’re expecting some light icing tonight, followed by a few scattered r*** showers on Sunday. Most of the day should be cloudy, and even if the wet stuff makes its way over here, it’ll still be a fun time. Please note, we're also expecting high winds tomorrow throughout the day, so check back here in case there are any lift delays. Our grooming team has been absolutely crushing it as they battle changing spring conditions each night. While our snow cover remains strong on most open runs, operators are strategizing how to best preserve surfaces and keep things skiing and riding late into the season. Your favorite groomed runs should be in great shape, from Caper over at Ramshead all the way to Wildfire at Bear Mountain. As a reminder, Sunday marks the final day for Snowshed laps, as well as trips down Great Eastern to the bottom of Skyeship, so if you’re looking for gentle cruisers, you know where to head. If you still have an appetite for moguls, no need to worry because we’ve got plenty. Downdraft and Great Bear should have pristine bumps, to name a couple, and we’re expecting much of the mountain to bump up later in the day, even on runs we’ve groomed. As the day progresses, surfaces should soften into wet granular conditions. Be sure to check out the Lifts & Trails Report for the full list of open terrain. Areas of thin cover exist as we move through this spring-like weather pattern. Ski Patrol is actively monitoring conditions and marking hazards. In some areas, walking may be required. Many of these spots are marked with signage, but additional gaps in coverage will appear, especially on ungroomed runs. The best beginner terrain is available over on Snowshed Slope, which is only accessible through Sunday. As we continue into spring, our grooming team will keep pushing snow around and patching up thinner areas where coverage allows. Our annual Easter Egg Hunt kicks off tomorrow at 8:30 a.m. for ages 12 and under, and at 9:30 a.m. for the little ones who are four and under. We've also decided to move our Easter Sunrise Service to the K-1 Lodge as there's a chance that high winds impact gondola operations in the morning, which would make our event at the Peak Lodge not feasible. More tickets are now available with all proceed benefiting the Killington Rec Department. Find tickets here , and we'll see you bright and early at 6:45 a.m. We are scheduled to have 16 lifts spinning with key lifts open at 8:00 a.m., with the Canyon and South Ridge Quads spinning at 10:00 a.m. On the kparks front, our Bear parks, Dream Maker and The Stash, are firing with a full lineup of features. Over on Ramshead, Timberline continues to shine with 42 features, 5 jumps, and a halfpipe. Our Parks Crew recently refreshed features in Timberline and gave the halfpipe a fresh cut. Easy Street and Lil’ Stash are also dialed in for fun progression options. Check the Terrain Parks Report for all the details. Lastly, check out our Base Lodge Music Schedule and dive into the music scene. Cap off your weekend with live tunes! Have a great rest of your weekend :) - Austin Operating Day: 143 Season passes for 26/27 are now on sale! Lock in the lowest price on Beast 365 or Winter Unlimited passes with lots of perks, plus free skiing & riding for the rest of this spring. And there's more good news for families: Youth & Child pass pricing has been significantly reduced for next season, with over $300 in savings available on Beast 365 access. Lifts Key lifts operate seven days a week from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. on Monday through Friday, and from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. on Saturday and Sunday. The North Ridge Quad will open at 9:30 a.m. on weekdays and 8:00 a.m. on weekends, the Canyon Quad will spin from 10:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Monday, Wednesday, Friday and 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. on weekends, and the Sunrise Village Triple will spin until 3:00 p.m. on weekdays and 4:00 p.m. on weekends. Upcoming lift closure dates: Snowshed Express Quad - Sunday, April 5th Skyeship Express Gondola Stage I - Sunday, April 5th Sunrise Village Triple - Sunday, April 5th A note for our snowboarders: Thanks to our new cabins on the Skyeship Gondola, we're asking you to please utilize the snowboard racks outside of each cabin. If the racks are entirely full, please put your boards underneath the seats. This differs from our K-1 Gondola, where all snowboards should be brought inside the cabins. Just remember: outside Skyeship, inside K-1! The Tubing Park presented by bubly is closed for the season. Uphill Travel Please visit killington.com/uphill for specific uphill route information, including a map of each route: Ramshead base to top of Ramshead Express Quad - Open Ramshead Express Quad to top of Snowdon Mountain - CLOSED Snowshed base to the top of Snowshed Slope - Open Base of Sunrise Village Triple to top of Bear Mountain - Open Killington/Pico Mountain Interconnect - CLOSED Pico Base to the top of Golden Express Quad - Open Pico Base to Pico Summit - Open Pico Summit Glade Route - CLOSED Before heading up the hill, be sure to review our uphill travel policies and grab your Uphill Travel Pass here . All uphill travelers are required to have an Uphill Travel Pass and armband, which can be picked up at any ticket window. Please keep an eye out for grooming equipment and steer clear of mountain ops during non-operating hours. copper mountain.note: Good morning, Copper Mountain athletes! Expect partly sunny skies today, with temperatures starting in the teens and climbing to around 34°F. Winds will be coming from the west to northwest at 5–10 mph, with gusts reaching the upper teens. Today marks the start of USASA 2026 Ski Week—get ready for an exciting lineup of competitions and events. Stay safe, and have a great time out there!

snowbird.note: Good morning! Kelsey here with your Snow Report for Saturday, April 4. While we may not be seeing the fresh snow that we saw yesterday, it’s going to be an amazing day. Shout out to our grooming team–honestly people, this crew has been working so hard to maintain the snowpack and they finally have some temps and snow to work with. Today, expect sunny skies with highs around 45 degrees. With some Utah resorts now closed, we are expecting a busy weekend. Please carpool! If you’re still in weekend planning mode, have I got some ideas for you. Today, we have the Mountain Dew Good Times Gathering on The Plaza Deck, followed by Plazapalooza with the one and only Pickpockets. Start your Sunday with our Easter Sunrise Service , followed by the YETI Easter Egg Hunt on Chickadee, capped off with Brunch at the Aerie . Also, in case you haven’t heard, we’re hosting The Blister Summit starting April 12. Conditions are prime and demos are aplenty. A quick reminder, Chickadee Lift will close for the 2025-26 season for replacement this Sunday, April 5. The new Chickadee Lift is expected to reopen for summer operations in July. Have fun and stay safe out there! Kelsey
